title: Weighted low-level Fourier bound
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$, and let $\rho\in\bbr$ satisfy $0\le\rho\le1$. If $\widehat f(S)$ denotes the Walsh–Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S\subseteq[n]$ and $T_\rho$ is the noise operator, then \[\rho^k\sum_{\substack{S\subseteq[n]\\|S|\le k}}\widehat f(S)^2\le\langle f,T_\rho f\rangle.\]
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $k\in\mathbb N$, and $0\le\rho\le1$. Then $\rho^k\sum_{|S|\le k}\widehat f(S)^2\le\mathbb E[fT_\rho f]$.
